paper.title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
paper.central_claim: Anneal's Failure-Driven Knowledge Acquisition converts recurring failures into governed (scored, guardrailed, canary-tested, versioned, rollback-able) symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without weight updates; across four domains and 27 multi-seed runs it is the only evaluated system committing persistent structural repairs, reducing holdout recurrence of the target failure to 0% where ReAct/Reflexion retain 72-100%; removing FDKA drops SR by up to 26.7 pp. Authors scope this to a narrow claim about persistent symbolic repair.

rationale: 作者报告：持久符号补丁使复发故障0%（基线72-100%），但故障为合成确定性注入、'3种子'轨迹相同、基线结构上无法留存修复，成本/替代对照缺失。

evidence.quote: We introduce Anneal , a neuro-symbolic agent that converts recurring failures into governed symbolic edits of a process knowledge graph without modifying foundation model weights.
evidence.support_explanation: Central object: typed operators/preconditions/tool schemas in a process knowledge graph (non-weight component).

evidence.quote: localizes the responsible operator, synthesizes a typed patch through constrained LLM generation, and validates the proposal via multi-dimensional scoring, symbolic guardrails, and canary testing before commit.
evidence.support_explanation: FDKA operation chain: localize -> propose -> score -> guardrail -> canary -> commit.

evidence.quote: treats the LLM strictly as a constrained code generator under a closed typed schema, so that all acceptance logic remains symbolic and auditable
evidence.support_explanation: Learned component confined to proposing a typed artifact; acceptance is symbolic.

evidence.quote: when fewer examples are available, a low-power mode evaluates the available examples/suite and rejects on any observed failure
evidence.support_explanation: Canary is up to 8 sandboxed runs; small-n regime handled by rejecting on any failure.

evidence.quote: (cold-start), relax acceptance threshold or queue for human review
evidence.support_explanation: With <3 retrieved traces the utility score is unreliable and acceptance is relaxed or deferred to humans: gate weakens exactly when evidence is scarce.

evidence.quote: In the evaluated runs, no rollbacks were observed.
evidence.support_explanation: Rollback / trust-based auto-rollback paths never exercised empirically.

evidence.quote: Across the 27 runs reported here, FDKA achieves 100% patch acceptance with no observed rollbacks
evidence.support_explanation: Every proposed patch accepted in routine runs, so the scoring/guardrail/canary filter never rejected anything outside the dedicated governance-stress suite.

evidence.quote: All agents solved the holdout tasks episodically, but only Anneal suppressed the target failure itself
evidence.support_explanation: Key result: SR identical (100%) while target-failure recurrence 0% vs 100% (Table 3).

evidence.quote: The stress suites are controlled synthetic injections designed for seeded reproducibility, not replayed production logs.
evidence.support_explanation: Failures are authored by the same team via deterministic injection.

evidence.quote: from real per-task metrics (seed 7; all seeds identical under deterministic failure injection)
evidence.support_explanation: The 3 'seeds' of the stress suites give identical trajectories: no independent replication, std=0 is by construction.

evidence.quote: over the matched 3-seed paired draws
evidence.support_explanation: Bootstrap (B=10,000) on 3 matched draws yields Δholdout-failure=-83.3pp, p<0.001 and ΔSR=+0.0pp, p=0.540; resampling n=3 deterministic draws gives no real inferential support.

evidence.quote: most cross-domain recoveries still come from verify-before-act and local repair rather than committed structural edits
evidence.support_explanation: Most routine-suite success is not attributable to committed patches.

evidence.quote: In e-commerce, removing FDKA drops SR by 26.7 pp (the largest single-component impact) and eliminates all structural repairs.
evidence.support_explanation: Store-off ablation inside the same architecture: 94.7 -> 68.0 SR (3 seeds).

evidence.quote: reflecting constraint types where verify-before-act catches violations that the repair loop does not yet cover
evidence.support_explanation: Removing Verify raises SR by +4.0 pp in e-commerce; Governance/Verify ablations are 0.0 pp elsewhere: those components have no demonstrated task benefit.

evidence.quote: so the stress-test attribution should not be overgeneralized
evidence.support_explanation: Authors caution about attributing routine-suite success to FDKA.

evidence.quote: Reflexion’s cross-episode verbal buffer remained empty in this run (within-episode recovery always succeeded), collapsing to ReAct-equivalent behaviour.
evidence.support_explanation: The Reflexion baseline had no stored lessons in the travel comparison: not a real test of text memory as a competitor.

evidence.quote: The current evidence supports a narrow claim about persistent symbolic repair, not broad general superiority.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors scope the claim themselves.

evidence.quote: but does not generalize across sibling operators with renamed fields or different schema hashes
evidence.support_explanation: Retention is content-addressed: transfer to sibling operators requires separate patches.

evidence.quote: This is paraphrased same-root recurrence at the instruction surface, not renamed-field or sibling-operator variation
evidence.support_explanation: Holdout generalization is limited to same-root recurrence (Anneal 0/18 vs Reflexion 7/18, ReAct 11/18).

evidence.quote: We do not make strong cost-ratio claims here because the current telemetry for token and latency accounting is incomplete in some scenarios.
evidence.support_explanation: No token/latency/call accounting for FDKA vs baselines.

evidence.quote: Under full governance, the synthesized migration from legacy auth_token to signed_session_token is escalated before commit on every task
evidence.support_explanation: Governance-stress suite: 6 proposals, 6 escalations, 0 commits, 0/6 recovered.

evidence.quote: Under a governance-off stress ablation, the same repair is committed on the first task and suppresses the remaining failures
evidence.support_explanation: Counterfactual gate-off run: 1 commit, 6/6 recovered; shows gate selectivity but also its cost (no recovery without human).

evidence.quote: A complementary synthetic 8-patch governance suite still achieves 100% decision accuracy
evidence.support_explanation: 8 synthetic patches labelled by the authors (3 commit / 3 escalate / 2 veto).

evidence.quote: not a broad cross-model study
evidence.support_explanation: One proposal-LLM swap (Haiku 4.5), 3 seeds, same edit_key.

evidence.quote: pre- and post-patch success rates are identical on every probe
evidence.support_explanation: 30/30 -> 30/30 on three probes; monotone-tightening argument.

evidence.quote: Its contribution is therefore narrower but more concrete: governed, weight-frozen structural repair of process knowledge rather than broad self-evolution over arbitrary agent components.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-stated delta against artifact-evolution neighbours.

evidence.quote: Broader framework over artifacts such as tools, workflows, and tests; less specifically centered on symbolic process-knowledge repair.
evidence.support_explanation: Closest neighbour (A-Evolve) distinguished only by description; not run as a baseline.

evidence.quote: no cross-episode memory or knowledge updates—failures recur across episodes
evidence.support_explanation: ReAct baseline cannot persist fixes by design.

evidence.quote: Model adaptation as a geometric process where each task independently proposes a correct patch with probability
evidence.support_explanation: TTA bound is a geometric tail bound with assumed detect/false-positive rates: not evidence of adaptation speed.

evidence.quote: observed TTA values for successfully patched failure classes ranged from 0 to 15 tasks depending on scenario and failure type
evidence.support_explanation: Observed time-to-adapt, only for successfully patched classes.

evidence.quote: Some commerce failures remain unresolved within the current operator-level edit space.
evidence.support_explanation: E-commerce order constraints: TTA infinite, residual RFR 35%; failure classes not repaired are reported.

evidence.quote: We constructed a targeted 12-task travel split with 3 early API-drift exposures on the flight-booking operator, 3 filler tasks, and then the same failure class reintroduced on 6 later holdout tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: Adaptation prefix vs later holdout of the same failure class; patch derived only from prefix failures.

evidence.quote: Extending to a third domain under the same untuned multi-seed protocol
evidence.support_explanation: ITSM 100% SR, 1.0 accepted patch, 3 seeds, thresholds not retuned.

evidence.quote: E-commerce : 25 tasks (order processing, payment validation, inventory management; easy difficulty as configured).
evidence.support_explanation: Suite sizes: 25 tasks per domain; stress suites 12 and 14 tasks.

evidence.quote: consistent with the view that episodic reflection does not eliminate the underlying operator fault
evidence.support_explanation: Reflexion SR 97.6% vs holdout order-placement failures 72.2% (14-task stress, 100% injected schema drift).

evidence.quote: All systems share identical planners, parsers, and domain ontologies; differences lie in adaptation mechanisms.
evidence.support_explanation: Claimed controlled comparison among Static-NS / LLM-Reflect / Verify-Only / ablations; ReAct is described separately as a per-step TAO loop, so the claim is not fully consistent.

signatures.object: Typed operator definitions (preconditions, effects, tool schemas) in the process knowledge graph consulted by the HTN planner; baseline = static operators (12 operators, empty experience pool).
signatures.information: Failure trace tau_t (states, actions, observation, symbolic state, error); minimal serialization (<=10 symbols) to the LLM; value/causal knowledge graphs for guardrails; retrieved similar traces (k=20) for utility; no weights, no oracle patch.
signatures.operation: Responsibility scoring over operators picks a target; GPT-4o-mini (T=0.3, closed JSON schema) emits a typed patch (precondition add / effect refine / tool-schema update); deterministic parse/type-check.
signatures.output: Delta-o patch with edit_key (content hash), provenance tuple, rollback set; committed operator version.
signatures.conditions: Operator-level failures (tool-schema drift, policy flips); hand-built ontology, operator library, and value/causal KGs; deterministic injected failures.
signatures.feedback: Execution failure trace; counterfactual replay on retrieved traces; sandboxed canary runs; Beta-Bernoulli trust from later outcomes.
signatures.selection_rule: Accept iff Score>=0.18 and value/causal guardrails allow, HITL gate (risk>0.6 or score<0.5 escalates), canary CSR>=0.8 (strict) / reject on any failure in low-power mode; edit_key conflict ledger; auto-rollback if trust<0.3 over 10 tasks.
signatures.selection_data: Retrieved traces and up to 8 canary scenarios from the same scenario family; no separate selection/test split for gate thresholds stated.
signatures.persistence: Versioned operator store with provenance; later planning consults patched operators; rollback sets allow one-step reversion.
signatures.later_use: Subsequent tasks replan with the patched operator (holdout tasks reintroducing the failure class).
signatures.claimed_effect: Holdout target-failure rate 0% vs 72-100% for ReAct/Reflexion/LLM-Reflect; SR 94.7-100%; FDKA ablation -4.0/-26.7 pp.
signatures.failure_boundary: Operator-level edits only; same-root recurrence only; sibling operators need separate patches; unresolved e-commerce failure classes; rollback/trust paths unexercised; cold-start relaxes acceptance.

gap.author_gap: Agents recover within an episode but repeatedly fail on the same fault because process knowledge (operator schemas, preconditions, constraints) stays unrepaired; prior self-evolving work updates prompts, memory, or weights and few give governance guarantees.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete and measurable (recurrence of the same tool/policy fault after in-episode recovery), and the object (typed operator store) is distinct from memory/prompt. But the premise is largely a property of the benchmark/system design: baselines that cannot edit operators necessarily keep failing, and a same-planner text-lesson baseline that records the fix is absent. Classical action-model/operator learning and program-repair lines are not engaged.
gap.lineage_closest_adjacent: Reflexion (2023), EvoTest (He 2025), EvolveR (Wu 2025), A-Evolve (Lin 2026, closest artifact-level evolution with verify/rollback), neuro-symbolic HTN planning (Kwon 2025), knowledge editing with edit keys (Zhang 2024). Only Table 1 text comparison; A-Evolve/EvoTest not run; full texts of neighbours not in this pack.
gap.residue: Whether symbolic patching beats a persistent text rule/lesson in the same planner; real-world (non-injected) recurring faults; sibling-operator transfer.
gap.stakes: Safe, auditable persistent repair for tool-API drift and policy flips in deployed agents.
gap.method_response: Typed patch under closed schema + layered symbolic validation + versioned commit.
gap.remaining_gap: Edit-space limited to operators; unresolved commerce constraints (Table 9); no cost accounting; evidence synthetic.
unresolved: Closest neighbours (A-Evolve, EvoTest) not available as pinned full text here; novelty beyond Table 1 text assertion not checkable.

matches.success_checks: Typed verifiable handoff: met; obtainable signals only: met; reusable capital (versioned patches): met; single load-bearing mechanism ablated to baseline: met for FDKA (SR 68.0 vs 94.7).
matches.failure_checks: Off-the-shelf assembly (many modules whose removal changes nothing: partial); cost unmeasured (present); single benchmark family (authored synthetic suites, present).
matches.reason: The LLM is confined to emitting a schema-conforming patch; acceptance is by sound symbolic checks, which is the C25 signature; differs from siblings (singleton).

rs_pattern.resolves_problem: partial: recurrence of injected same-root faults is closed in synthetic suites; real-world and sibling-operator recurrence not shown

Admissibility + marginal-gain tests (utility replay, canary: met); regression budget (capability probes: partial); retirement on accumulated harm (trust<0.3: designed, unexercised); versioned provenance (met); governance shown to prevent a named silent failure (auth migration escalation: partial).

revision_proposals: Consider a condition under H30/H12 for 'symbolic typed-schema patches with deterministic rollback sets' if >=2 further full-text papers share it.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: RS: model emits machine-checkable artifact consumed by sound solver and loop closed on verifier output. Domain: failure trace -> localized edit to the incumbent artifact -> replay/canary check -> commit/rollback. Both = generate-then-mechanically-validate an edit to a persistent artifact.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: RS focus is the learned/solver seam; domain card focus is credit assignment and retention. Anneal's incumbent is a symbolic operator store, which makes the validator exact where H12 harnesses rely on replay.

expectations.reason: Responsibility scoring selects one target operator; patches are operator-local; localization accuracy never measured.

claims.text: Anneal is the only evaluated system that commits persistent structural repairs while achieving 94.7-100% task success.
claims.setting: Travel planning/stochastic, e-commerce; 25 tasks each; 3 seeds
claims.baseline_control: ReAct, Reflexion (OpenAI family), LLM-Reflect, Static-NS, Verify-Only
claims.selection_vs_test: Online per-task adaptation within each suite; no separate split
claims.result_denominator: Table 2: 3 agents x 3 scenarios x 3 seeds = 27 runs; SR ties at ~100% in travel
claims.allowed_conclusion: Anneal alone commits patches (by design); episodic SR is not higher than Reflexion (98.7% vs 94.7% in e-commerce).

claims.text: Committed patches reduce holdout recurrence of the target failure to 0% vs 72-100% for baselines.
claims.setting: Travel 12-task split (3 exposures, 3 filler, 6 holdout) and e-commerce 14-task split with 100% injected schema drift; paraphrased holdout 18 tasks
claims.selection_vs_test: Patch created from prefix failure; evaluated on later holdout tasks of the same failure root
claims.result_denominator: 3 seeds identical; 6 holdout tasks per seed (travel), 18 (paraphrase)
claims.allowed_conclusion: In synthetic same-root recurrence, a committed schema/precondition patch removes the repeat tool error; not shown for sibling operators or real logs.

claims.text: Removing FDKA drops SR up to 26.7 pp and eliminates structural repairs; arbitration -4.7 pp under noise.
claims.result_denominator: Table 4; -4.0 pp deterministic travel, 0.0 stochastic, -26.7 e-commerce; -Verify +4.0
claims.allowed_conclusion: FDKA matters in e-commerce and a little in travel; Governance and Verify show no benefit on task success.

claims.setting: 8 synthetic patches and a 6-task auth-drift suite
claims.allowed_conclusion: Gate escalates the one constructed high-risk case; no evidence about false-reject rate or gate value on realistic patch streams.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: In authored deterministic suites, a committed typed patch to an operator/tool schema persists and eliminates later repeats of the same-root failure, which in-episode retry baselines (ReAct/Reflexion/LLM-Reflect) do not (author-reported, not reproduced by us); FDKA is the load-bearing component in e-commerce.
unresolved: Benefit over a persistent text-lesson baseline in the same planner.
Real (non-injected) recurring faults and sibling-operator transfer.
Value of Governance/Verify/Arbitration beyond the constructed stress cases.

G.reason: gap 具体且可观测（同一故障复发），对象为类型化操作符库而非记忆；Table 1 区分了最近邻，边界（仅算子级）清楚；但最近邻未跑、经典 action-model 学习/程序修复未涉及。

M.reason: 局部化→封闭 schema 补丁→符号校验→版本化提交的因果链可重建，并给出可区分预测（复发率→0）；但多数组件（Governance/Verify）无增益，评分权重无依据，未与同 planner 文本规则替代方案比较。

X.reason: 版本化回滚集、provenance、冲突台账、信任降级与 HITL 门控，下一轮由 planner 读取补丁均可重建，边界在 §6 说明；但回滚/退休路径从未触发，冷启动放宽接受门槛，edit_key 不跨兄弟算子。

E.measurement.reason: SR 天花板(~100%)，关键指标'目标故障复发率'由作者注入的确定性合成故障定义，基线结构上无法改变其值；指标可信但近乎由设计保证，缺少成本/步骤等结局度量。

E.causality.reason: 有 FDKA 关闭、治理关/开等同架构对照，较好；但缺同 planner 的持久文本规则/其他修复器对照，基线架构不同且 Reflexion 缓冲为空，Verify/Governance 消融无收益。

E.holdout.reason: 补丁仅由前缀失败生成，后续同根复发/改写指令/ITSM 未调参域评测，范围与主张（复发消除）匹配并诚实限定；仍限同根复发、合成注入。

E.statistics.reason: 3 个'种子'因确定性注入轨迹完全相同，std=0 无信息；在 n=3 配对抽样上做 bootstrap 报 p<0.001 不具推断力；套件仅 12-25 任务，无独立重复。

E.cost.reason: 仅有单次检查延迟(<5ms/Z3 20-50ms)与'<2分钟'周期，作者承认 token/延迟计量不完整，无总调用数/与基线预算对比。
